name: open_pr

args_redacted.title: Fix off-by-one error in paginate.py
args_redacted.body: The `page` function was computing `end = start + size + 1`, which caused it to include one extra item (the first item of the next page). Fixed by removing the `+ 1` so `end = start + size`.

diff:
diff --git a/src/paginate.py b/src/paginate.py
index 5e83767..cc763c3 100644
--- a/src/paginate.py
+++ b/src/paginate.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def page(items, number, size):
     start = number * size
-    end = start + size + 1  # BUG: off by one
+    end = start + size
     return items[start:end]
